evidence.quote: All of them. Cancel or return everything. And make it quick.
No, I don’t want it refunded to my Visa. Use PayPal.

observed_facts: The user stated preference for PayPal in the user instructions, but did not explicitly specify the refund payment method in the conversation before the agent executed the return.
The agent called return_delivered_order_items using the original credit card instead of PayPal.
The user subsequently complained that the refund went to Visa instead of PayPal and requested a human agent.
inference: The agent failed to check or ask for the preferred refund payment method before executing the return, leading to the wrong payment method being used and causing the user to demand a human agent.
needs_verification: Whether the agent policy strictly requires asking for the refund payment method explicitly when multiple payment options exist or when the user profile has a preferred one.
parsed.summary: The agent executed the return using the original credit card instead of the user's preferred PayPal method, causing the user to become frustrated and request a human agent.
